scope: source-packet reopen-trigger matrix; no OCR, extraction, key derivation, hashing, seed/WIF/address checks, BIP39 checks, or broad candidate generation

r1r5Gates.name: source identity
r1r5Gates.passCondition: new material must be physically/original-layout distinct from the byte-locked current scan

r1r5Gates.name: target preservation
r1r5Gates.passCondition: must preserve or clearly explain O5, G5, L26-L29, and the p78 frame contact pattern

r1r5Gates.name: unit/order evidence
r1r5Gates.passCondition: must name or visibly supply the extraction unit/order before any key checks resume

r1r5Gates.name: orientation discipline
r1r5Gates.passCondition: must state whether coordinates are readable/upright or native/source and apply the 180-degree guardrail

r1r5Gates.name: controlled improvement
r1r5Gates.passCondition: must improve a compact benchmark, preferably dx -38/-40 G5 edge repair, O5 bottom contact, M3 right-edge cut, or the p77 one-line near miss

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: source/clue text or source-visible layout must name a unit/order such as word, letter, line, edge, font, first/last, left/right, or equivalent
minimumReopenConditions.why: Without this, local geometry only repeats target discovery.

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: physical scan/photo/hold-to-light/spread should create repeated direct O5/G5 contacts or improve the p77 71.93px near miss under one natural transform
minimumReopenConditions.why: Current best scan gives zero true physical O5/G5 overlaps.

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: original Canva/export/browser/source asset must exceed thumbnail status and visibly resolve the #0, p79 pills, XX/barbed-wire, or p78 frame benchmarks
minimumReopenConditions.why: The current Canva surface is only a 668x376 investigator note thumbnail.

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: new source should naturally preserve or explain `should sell | Volcano Bonds | shitcoiner at heart`, current O5 clip, M3 right-edge cut, and dx≈-38/-40 G5 edge repair
minimumReopenConditions.why: This is the compactest existing registration signature.

triggerRows.temptingMatch: OBBO/YKKY color-state match: color palindrome=True, visual palindrome=True
triggerRows.controlledBy: full-page Y/K non-active controls=4; OVERDOSE controls=NNNNNNNNN
requiredToReopen: line order 22/25/27/32
corridor order 4/7/9/14
source-backed unit/order wording
triggerRows.externalObservable: A distinct source/original layout explicitly ties Y/K or orange/black order to a reading unit and preserves readable order 22/25/27/32.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: original export/source layer or raw clue text; not a resaved scan
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: R1 distinct source + R3 unit/order + R4 readable/native orientation + controls do not reproduce the same color/order logic
triggerRows.currentBlocker: YKKY/OBBO is palindromic and full-page Y/K has four non-active controls.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

requiredToReopen: rotate native source images 180 degrees
recover readable/upright active order
reject raw-native reversed order as orientation error
triggerRows.externalObservable: Source provenance states native coordinate direction, or a fresh extraction proves the active quartet after the documented 180-degree transform.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: native source image/PDF extraction with page orientation metadata
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: R4 orientation discipline; raw-native reversed order must not be accepted as a match
triggerRows.currentBlocker: Native raw order reverses to 32/27/25/22 and 14/9/7/4 unless rotated 180 degrees.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

triggerRows.controlledBy: C9 is broad, horizontally mirror-invariant, and source-validation only
requiredToReopen: source wording that names the frame as a reading boundary
unit/order wording inside or tied to the frame
controls must fail under the same rule
triggerRows.externalObservable: Source shows the C9/Y-K frame as an intentional reading boundary and names the units/order inside it.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: original layout layer or source note with frame/read instruction
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: All four active targets inside, context leakage avoided, p75/frame controls fail under the same rule
triggerRows.currentBlocker: C9 frame fully contains the quartet but is broad, mirror-invariant, and source-validation only.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

triggerRows.controlledBy: p75 control OVER projections=2; mirrored p75 matches active=8/8
requiredToReopen: raw/source instruction tying OVERDOSE glyph slots to active boxes
control pages must not reproduce the same slot stream
explicit unit/order extraction wording
triggerRows.externalObservable: Source explicitly links OVERDOSE glyph slots to active boxes and names which glyph/slot stream to read.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: raw source clue, original layout annotation, or higher-fidelity source showing slot linkage
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: Active slot rule succeeds, p75 control no longer reproduces it, and R3 unit/order is explicit
triggerRows.currentBlocker: p75 control reproduces OVER-style slot streams; active mirrored variants are not unique.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

triggerRows.temptingMatch: repaired p78 max partial=2/4; max full=0/4
requiredToReopen: source-backed reason for dx repair
all four active boxes inside without context-band leakage
unit/order wording
triggerRows.externalObservable: Physical/original source naturally explains dx≈-38/-40 or shows the p78 frame shifted/cut in that position without manual tuning.
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: R5 controlled improvement plus all active targets inside without artificial expansion
triggerRows.currentBlocker: dx repair improves G5/O5 residuals but still gives max full containment 0/4 and max partial 2/4.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

requiredToReopen: new source must avoid L22-L32 context-band leakage
new source must isolate target units
hard instruction wording must be present
triggerRows.externalObservable: New source isolates O4/B4/G5/O5 as units without taking the full L22-L32 lower-corridor context band.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: source crop/layer/physical transform that cleanly bounds only the active quartet
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: All four active targets isolated; non-target context and non-active format signals fall away
triggerRows.currentBlocker: Full cover spans 102 words, 92 non-target words, and four non-active format signals.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

triggerRows.controlledBy: witness conflicts=2; Markdown/notes are witness layers
requiredToReopen: DOCM/high-res/crop-pack agreement
source-backed unit/order wording
do not rely on Markdown bold or annotated notes alone
triggerRows.externalObservable: Source or provenance explicitly says to read/take/count bold, highlight, first/last, or a comparable format unit.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: DOCM/source-layer instruction, raw clue, or original annotation source
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: R3 format unit/order is explicit and Markdown/user notes are not the sole evidence
triggerRows.currentBlocker: DOCM/high-res/crop-pack validate format only; line-level bold and annotations conflict or remain witness layers.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

requiredToReopen: use canonical plain text + DOCM text + Markdown transcript
use 3D OCR only as geometry witness
do not extract key text from corrupted target-box OCR
triggerRows.externalObservable: A source text layer supplies exact text inside the target boxes, or OCR is replaced by canonical text authority tied to a unit/order instruction.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: source text extraction or authoritative transcript, not 3D box OCR alone
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: Exact O4/B4/G5/O5 text is source-backed and tied to R3 unit/order
triggerRows.currentBlocker: 3D active-box OCR has 0/4 exact matches and 4/4 corrupted/misread target boxes.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

triggerRows.controlledBy: alignment first pad failure is already below loose visual matching
requiredToReopen: explain any shift larger than current tolerance
preserve line/corridor order and visual state
pass all R1-R5 source-reopen gates
triggerRows.externalObservable: New source explains any shift beyond the current ±4px tolerance through provenance, scaling, crop, or physical registration.
triggerRows.minimumArtifact: source asset with measurable registration transform
triggerRows.acceptanceTest: Transform is natural, repeatable, improves source benchmarks, and passes R1-R5
triggerRows.currentBlocker: Future matches outside the current narrow tolerance are false positives unless the source explains the shift.
triggerRows.missingEvidence: R3 source-backed unit/order absent; R1-R5 not satisfied by current scan/local derivatives.

decision.reason: Every visually tempting path now has an explicit source/provenance trigger, but none is satisfied by the current scan, local text layers, generated reports, or local source derivatives.

nextMove: Use this matrix when a new source/photo/original export/clue arrives: score the observed source change against the exact trigger row before any selector or key work resumes.
